finding.issue: TASK-173 requires a missing or blank variation-group label to fail closed and explicitly forbids Quantity/stock controls or unrelated content from becoming variation groups. The new selection-box inference does not preserve that boundary. hasGroupLabelEvidence(...) accepts any non-empty descendant span/div/p outside option descendants as group-label evidence, and group-label extraction later uses the same broad fallback. For an uncovered selection-box option, ancestor inference therefore keeps climbing until it finds arbitrary surrounding text. In the real Shopee hierarchy that motivated TASK-173, the enclosing details branch also contains Quantity/stock text. If the true Model label is missing or blank, that unrelated text can make a higher ancestor look like a labelled variation group and can be emitted as the group label instead of selected_variants remaining incomplete. The current missing/blank-label regression does not detect this because its synthetic product card omits the surrounding Quantity/stock sibling text that was present in the captured live hierarchy. This also weakens AC4's deterministic labelled-group boundary.
